mapper.select: SELECT p.PRODUCT_NUMBER, p.NAME, p.DESCRIPTION, p.PRICE, p.QUANTITY, p.CREATED_DATE, s.ID as salesPostId, s.PRODUCT_NUMBER as salesPostProductNumber, s.TITLE as salesPostTitle, s.DESCRIPTION as salesPostDescription, s.CREATED_DATE as salesPostCreatedDate, s.UPDATED_DATE as salesPostUpdatedDate, s.START_POST_DATE as salesPostStartPostDate, s.LAST_POST_DATE as salesPostLastPostDate, s.STATUS as salesPostStatus FROM PRODUCT_TB p LEFT JOIN SALES_POST_TB s ON p.PRODUCT_NUMBER = s.PRODUCT_NUMBER
SELECT ID, PRODUCT_NUMBER, ORIGINAL_NAME, FILE_PATH, FILE_TYPE, UPLOAD_DATE FROM PRODUCT_FILE_TB

SELECT PRODUCT_TB.PRODUCT_NUMBER, PRODUCT_TB.NAME, PRODUCT_TB.DESCRIPTION, PRODUCT_TB.PRICE, PRODUCT_TB.QUANTITY, PRODUCT_TB.CREATED_DATE FROM PRODUCT_TB JOIN PRODUCT_CATEGORY_MAPPING_TB ON PRODUCT_TB.PRODUCT_NUMBER = PRODUCT_CATEGORY_MAPPING_TB.PRODUCT_NUMBER WHERE PRODUCT_CATEGORY_MAPPING_TB.CATEGORY_ID = #{categoryId}
